top_signals.title: Gold Erases Weekly Gain as Traders Weigh Inflation and Fed Path
top_signals.summary: Gold declined, as the risk of persistent inflation continued to weigh even after the Federal Reserve’s first hike since 2023 reassured markets that efforts were in motion to combat it.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Only America Could Have Designed the Field Jacket
top_signals.summary:
When the M-1943 field jacket was introduced at the height of World War II, it was a revolutionary garment.
